title: Farmers Market Vendor Request Form
subtitle: Farmers Market Vendor Operation: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Farmers Market Vendor Request Form covers vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout. The market vendor coordinator records Farmers Market Vendor Operation need, timing, access, and assignment. Farmers Market Vendor Request Form keeps Farmers Market Vendor Operation exceptions visible until the market vendor coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Farmers Market Vendor Request Form at market, booth, vehicle, storage cooler, display, and customer service area. Document vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout identity before Farmers Market Vendor Operation begins. Compare vendor, market date, product, lot, booth, cold-holding control, sale, and closeout findings with stated Farmers Market Vendor Operation criteria; route unresolved Farmers Market Vendor Operation issues to market operations or food-safety reviewer. For Farmers Market Vendor Request Form, confirm requirements for Farmers Market Vendor Operation. Ask market operations or food-safety reviewer to review Farmers Market Vendor Operation conditions beyond the market vendor coordinator's role.

blocks.guidance: Do not assign or authorize the Farmers Market Vendor Operation request when vendor authority, product trace, display control, complaint, or product disposition remains unresolved. Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to market vendor coordinator.
